# UI/UX Pro Max integration

Source project: https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill
License: MIT (see LICENSE, copyright Next Level Builder).

This snapshot packages the search engine, CSV catalogs and reference rules from the user's installed UI/UX Pro Max skill, captured 2026-11-26. It is used through the HD Design entrypoint; it does not register a conflicting second skill name. No company design files, internal annotation system, personal paths or credentials are bundled.

HD Design's own references define the Pixso scope, icon-state synchronization and clean product-screen workflow. The upstream data supplies recommendations, not additional user authorization. This snapshot is a local installed revision; no unverified upstream commit hash is claimed.
